lines: Oh dear, I think I gave that poor guard too many Pewter Crunchies to eat...
They are rather dry if you dont have any tea or anything to wash them down...
It's rumored that CLEFAIRYs came from the moon!
They appeared after MOON STONE fell on MT.MOON.
What!? TEAM ROCKET is at MT.MOON?
Huh? I'm on the phone! Scram!
We are proud of 2 fossils of very rare, prehistoric POKEMON!
Ssh! I think that this chunk of AMBER contains POKEMON DNA!
It would be great if POKEMON could be resurrected from it!
But, my colleagues just ignore me! So I have a favor to ask!
reward: Take this to a POKEMON LAB and get it examined!
Ssh! Get the OLD AMBER checked!

lines: Are you the twerp messing with my grunts?
battle: Little kid, you think you're brave, eh? I'll teach you a valuable lesson.
Whatever, we've done everything we needed. I won't be as nice to you next time.
We're pulling a big job here! Get lost, kid!
If you find a fossil, give it to me and scram!

lines: I'm Brock! I'm Pewter's Gym Leader! I believe in rock hard defense and determination!
That's why my Pokémon are all the rock-type!
battle: Do you still want to challenge me? Fine then! Show me your best!
I took you for granted. As proof of your victory, here's the Boulder Badge! That's an official Pokémon League Badge!
There are all kinds of trainers in the world! You appear to be very gifted as a Pokémon trainer! Go to the Gym in Cerulean and test your abilities!
reward: TM39 contains Rock Tomb. It hurls boulders at the foe and lowers its Speed.
